    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CameraModel
    Published specs of common FRC vision cameras, for simulating them.
    LimelightWrapper
    A Limelight, through LimelightLib 2.
    PhotonVisionFrames
    Turns PhotonVision results into YALL frames.
    PhotonVisionWrapper
    A PhotonVision camera.
    PoseEstimationMode
    How a camera turns the AprilTags it sees into a robot pose.
    PoseFilterStats
    Counts of what a camera's pose filter accepted and rejected, and how spread out the accepted poses are.
    SynapseWrapper
    A Synapse camera.
    TelemetryVerbosity
    How much a camera publishes to NetworkTables.
    VisionCamera
    A camera from any supported vendor, with one API for targets and robot pose estimates.
    VisionCameraConfig
    Settings shared by every VisionCamera, whatever the vendor.
    VisionFrame
    One frame read from a camera, before the pose filter.
    VisionPoseEstimate
    A robot pose estimated from AprilTags, ready for a WPILib pose estimator.
    VisionPoseFilter
    Decides which vision pose estimates to trust, and how much.
    VisionResult
    One processed camera frame, in the same form for every camera vendor.
    VisionSim
    The simulated world every simulated VisionCamera sees, whatever its vendor.
    VisionSystem
    Several VisionCameras working together, from any mix of vendors.
    VisionTarget
    One target a camera sees, in the same form for every camera vendor.
    VisionTelemetryConfig
    What a camera publishes to NetworkTables, and where.
    VisionTelemetryField
    One group of values a camera can publish, and the lowest verbosity that publishes it.
